items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Woodrow lived right around the corner from me.

ctx.x: His wife's been real sick and I haven't heard very much of her.
Yeah, well he's married Steve Woodrow's wife. He's married to Steve Woodrow's wife. And Woodrow's dad died, you see. And since Woodrow's dad, he married Woodrow's wife.
Well Steve Woodrow was a drummer with a triangle. That's right.
